text.text_excerpt: The bar only seems to have small bites (along with great cocktails and a quite good wine list by the glass) but the dining room - if you can get a reservation - has amazing food. Maybe a bit overpriced for NOLA/Bywater at $98 per person plus $55 for a wine pairing but pretty astounding food and there are only 5 tables with a total of 12 seats. On a recent visit, we started with an fantastic broth dish followed by an uni bowl (where the uni didn't necessary star but was great nonetheless) then a single scallop perfectly cooked and with fantastic accompaniments. Steak was the final savory course followed by a pineapple dish with rum ice cream. Each individual course was on the smaller side,...

I have now been to Saint Germain on multiple occasions. And they never cease to amaze me. The food, the wine, the service, and the experience are beyond words. Alas, l will try my best. Saint-Germain is forever blowing my tastebuds with the creations coming out of their kitchen. The vegetarian week in the dining room was no exception. If you haven't been to Saint-Germain, let me introduce you. The dining room features a 5 course menu (&laniappe). If you are an alcohol consumer, you can choose to do a wine pairing, a bottle (which is what we went with), or à la carte from the wine by the glass & drink menu. The dining room menu is curated using fresh, local ingredients and changes every mo...

I came in on a Friday night and grabbed seats at the bar. They serve small plates and we got the house made cheese and chicken liver pate. Simple right? NO. I was blown away!! It was amazing and every bite was delectable with their aged bread. They have a separate dining room with maybe 16 seats and I really need to get a reservation because wow. This place is truly a gem.
